concern_summary: This concern encompasses the functionalities related to the deletion of a saved search, including user confirmation, state updates during the deletion process, and handling different deletion outcomes.

This concern involves the functionalities for managing saved searches, including the saving of a new search query with the option to assign a name and the renaming of existing saved searches while maintaining the original query parameters.
This concern focuses on managing keyboard shortcuts, specifically the handling of the Enter key within the context of triggering actions and navigational responses.
This concern encapsulates the behavior and action triggers associated with the usage of the Enter key, including form submission and executing callback functions based on key events.
Validation of user input for saved search functionalities, ensuring display names are properly checked for validity before they are used in searches.

This concern centers around the management and execution of search queries. It includes building, standardizing, executing queries, and handling user input to ensure relevant search results are retrieved and displayed.

This concern captures the functionalities associated with initiating and handling search actions in the user interface, ensuring a smooth user experience when navigating search-related tasks and managing search parameters.
The functionalities focused on managing and displaying expense types, enabling users to filter their saved searches based on selected categories of expenses.
This concern involves the action associated with activating hyperlinks through the Enter key, allowing for navigation to specified URLs.

This concern focuses on the user interface aspects of displaying saved search results. The functionalities together provide a smooth user experience when presenting search results, including loading indicators and interactive sorting capabilities.
